basic_profile.bio: I'm an archery enthusiast from Orlando, Florida, trying to learn as much as I can about different bow types. I'm currently working as a junior software developer, which keeps me busy during weekdays, but I always find time for archery practice on weekends. I live with my girlfriend and our two cats. I started getting into archery about a year ago after attending a local renaissance fair and fell in love with it. I also enjoy video games and have a growing interest in learning how to make violins. My typical online hours are late evenings after work and Sunday afternoons.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in archery is mostly self-taught through online resources and community forums. I lean a lot on YouTube tutorials and Reddit discussions to improve my skills. I have no formal training, but I enjoy experimenting with different techniques and equipment.
